name: Staff of Imperious Echo
text:
The human leader of a surface-dwelling Yiggite cult once carried this +3 major striking greater impactful staff as a symbol of station. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy or Intimidation checks against creatures who are frightened or under the effects of any spell cast by you that has the mental trait.

Activate—Anamnesis 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per round

---
Effect You siphon strategic insight from your past incarnations, gaining a +2 status bonus to skill checks you make to Recall Knowledge until the start of your next turn. Whenever you Aid an ally while under this effect, your ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus on a success instead of +1, and if you roll any result worse than a success, you get a success instead. The outcome of a critical success is unchanged.

---
Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

---
- Cantrip Guidance

- 1st Command, Enfeeble

- 2nd Paranoia, Stupefy

- 3rd Haste, Hypercognition

- 4th Rewrite Memory, Telepathy

- 5th Hallucination, Truespeech

- 6th Never Mind, Truesight

- 7th Retrocognition, True Target

- 8th Divine Inspiration, Pinpoint

- 9th Duplicate Foe, Project Image

- 10th Freeze Time
